title: app/sitemap.ts is not served at /sitemap.xml on NextJS 15RC

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issue was opened via the bug report template.

body:
### Link to the code that reproduces this issue

https://github.com/amannn/nextjs-bugrepro-sitemap

### To Reproduce

1. Run the app
2. Visit `/sitemap.xml`

### Current vs. Expected behavior

For `app/sitemap.ts` to be served at `/sitemap.xml` instead of being served at `/sitemap`. I suspect this started happening after this pull request was merged: https://github.com/vercel/next.js/pull/65507

Someone else has experienced the same problem and raised it in that pull request.

### Provide environment information

```bash

  react-dom: 19.0.0-rc-f994737d14-20240522
```

### Which area(s) are affected? (Select all that apply)

Not sure

### Which stage(s) are affected? (Select all that apply)

next dev (local), next build (local), next start (local), Vercel (Deployed)

### Additional context

This is seems to be working with NextJS 14.2.3. The problem is happening on NextJS 15.0.0 RC 0.
